## Improvement contract

**Observed gap:**

**Why this transfers beyond the originating project:**

**Change type:** knowledge / specialization / harness code / installation /
documentation

## Evidence and provenance

Describe the retained source, before/after behavior, model or tool context needed
for reproduction, and anything that remains unverified. Model agreement is not
primary evidence.

**Material AI assistance:** none / tool and model details

## Verification

List the exact checks run and their results.

## Safety and review

- [ ] I removed secrets, customer data, private project source, and unlicensed
      material.
- [ ] I reviewed the complete diff and may license my contribution under MIT.
- [ ] I searched existing namespaces and issues before adding new knowledge.
- [ ] I did not modify or delete an existing canonical manifest or claim.
- [ ] New replacement claims name predecessors in `lineage.parent_refs`.
- [ ] Namespace metadata changes use a new generation with `supersedes`.
- [ ] Authority and evidence class match the retained evidence.
- [ ] `python bin/aikb.py --repo . validate --projection` passes.
- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v` passes.
- [ ] A maintainer will review before merge, or I am the sole maintainer and
      have said so here.
